# Jaeyeon (Jae) Chung

> Official academic website of Jaeyeon (Jae) Chung, William S. Mackey Jr. Distinguished Assistant Professor of Marketing at Rice University.

## Primary identity
- Name: Jaeyeon (Jae) Chung
- Field: Marketing / Consumer Behavior
- Affiliation: Rice University, Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business
- Website: https://jaechung.org/

## Areas of expertise
- Consumer behavior, consumer perception, consumer judgment, and consumer decision making
- Digital marketing, advertising response, and online persuasion
- Social media, social influence, popularity signals, influencers, and engagement
- Artificial intelligence and consumer behavior
- Personalized recommendation systems, recommendation algorithms, platform trust, information credibility, and belief
- Online platforms, digital marketplaces, digital ownership, NFTs, virtual reality, and prediction markets
- Survey research, survey design, behavioral experiments, causal evidence, marketplace data, digital traces, and text analysis
